newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni lowers reference rate to 12.35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni lowers reference rate to 12.35 pct.

text.p: Komercni Banka, the Czech republic's largest commercial bank, on Tuesday said it was lowering its reference lending rate to 12.35 percent from 12.6 percent, effective January 22.
The lowering of the reference rate reflects the movement of interbank money market deposit rates," Komercni spokeswoman Irena Satavova said.
She gave no further details on the move.
Czech interbank market rates have fallen some 40-50 basis points since the beginning of the year, and some dealers say they could fall slightly further in the coming weeks.
On Monday, the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR) ranged from 12.37 percent on overnight finds, to 11.89 percent on six month money.
